Like, a whole frozen pizza, a bag of chips, and then some ice cream, all in one sitting. I don't stop until I feel stretched and bloated, like I’m going to pop. I try to do it when no one's around; the thought of someone seeing me eat like that, it's just embarrassing.

Then there are other times, maybe for a few days, when I feel like I'm running on rocket fuel. I'll barely sleep, maybe two or three hours, but I'm not tired. My mind races with ideas for side projects, things I used to enjoy but haven't touched in years. I get really talkative too, and sometimes I feel a bit irritable when things don't go my way. Mostly, though, I just feel... up. Like I could conquer the world. But those days always give way to the emptiness again, and I'm back to the food. It's a cycle I can’t seem to break.
D023-D009_h001.question_a: Well, doctor, it's been going on for about three and a half months now. I just... I can't seem to stop myself from eating these enormous amounts of food, especially when I'm alone. I get so embarrassed when I’m eating, and I feel like if anyone saw the sheer quantity I’m putting away, they’d judge me. I usually eat until I’m painfully stuffed, to the point of feeling sick. This happens at least once a week, and sometimes more. I also have times when I feel really high, full of energy like I can conquer anything, and then crash into a deep sadness. However, even with those ups and downs, it's the eating that truly feels out of control. I don't think it's enough to be considered bipolar, because the "up" periods aren't that severe, more just buzzing. It’s the eating that’s really affecting my life.

It feels great at the time, but then I crash. And that's when the eating starts. I’ll make a huge meal, or order a ton of takeout, and just devour it until my stomach hurts. I try to eat alone because I'm so embarrassed by how much I'm putting away. It's been like this for about six months now. Alright doc, thanks for seeing me. Things have been... a bit much lately. I just feel so wired sometimes, buzzing with ideas for new designs, staying up all night sketching, feeling like I can take on the world. Then it crashes. And when I say crashes, I mean I just shut down. I barely leave my apartment, the thought of picking up a tattoo gun feels impossible.

When I get like that, I just... eat. I’ll order a ton of takeout, or just raid the fridge, and polish it all off by myself. I get this feeling of dread about how much I'm consuming, so I usually just eat alone. Sometimes, I don't even stop until my stomach genuinely hurts, just painfully full. It's been happening for a few months now, these ups and downs, and the eating thing happens a couple times a week when I'm in that low place. My clients are starting to notice I'm either on fire or completely gone. I just want to feel… balanced again.
D023-D009_h005.question_a:
Lately, things have been pretty rough. I’m 38, still single, and my tattoo parlor used to be where I channeled all my focus, but even that’s not helping much anymore. I've been holed up more often, and it's mostly about the food. I'll just keep eating until my stomach feels like it's going to burst. I usually do it when no one else is around – I mean, who wants to see that? It’s not a regular meal; it's like a frenzy where I just can't stop shoveling food in. It’s been happening for about three months now, at least once a week, and it leaves me feeling disgusted with myself.

There are also these other times, though, where I feel like I'm on top of the world. My ideas for new designs flow constantly, I barely need sleep, and I feel incredibly productive, almost buzzing with energy. But it never gets to the point where my life spirals out of control, or anyone around me thinks I'm acting totally out of character. I can still go to work, my business is doing okay, and I don’t feel like I’m losing touch with reality. It’s a distinct shift from feeling down or bingeing, but I wouldn’t call it losing myself, you know? It’s more like a really good, extremely creative mood.
D023-D009_h005.question_b:
"Lately, things have been a real rollercoaster. I've been sleeping maybe two or three hours a night, feeling wired, full of ideas for new tattoo designs, and I just can't sit still. My shop's a mess because I keep starting new projects and not finishing them. I snap at my clients more than I should, and my friends tell me I'm talking a mile a minute.

Then there are these episodes where I find myself just devouring food. I'll order a huge spread, way more than I can eat, and just keep going until my stomach hurts so bad I can barely move. I usually do it late at night, alone in my apartment, because I'd be mortified if anyone saw how much I was putting away. It feels like I'm not even in control, and it's been happening a few times a week for the past couple of months, always after these periods where I'm just buzzing with energy."
